name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.payapi.alipay.AlipayActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens an embedded payment page for the Alipay content returned by order checkout. Its web view handles payment-page navigation and results.
disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the Alipay payment route for purchases.
